title: Make Modulo Squares your own
instructions: Speak in a warm, relaxed, conversational American English voice, as if showing a friend a game on your phone. Natural phrasing and gentle variation in pitch. Clear but unhurried, about 145 words per minute. No announcer voice, exaggerated enthusiasm, sing-song cadence, or dramatic pauses. Read only the supplied words. Pronounce Modulo as MOD-yoo-loh.
disclosure: Narration is AI-generated using OpenAI's Cedar voice.

segments.text: Want a different look for your next run? In Modulo Squares, open Settings, then Appearance. Choose a palette and tap Save.
Deep Ocean gives you a dark blue board with cool, clear accents.
For something brighter, try Arcade Neon.
Warm Sunset brings a softer, warmer feel to the board.
Or switch to Candy Pop for a playful burst of color.
The colors change, but the challenge stays the same. Find a divisor, line up your number, and make a clean landing.
